name: Circles and Lines
description: Three SVG elements — circle, ellipse and line — written as one Code node, so the array order is the paint order.

data.comment:
# Circles and Lines

Draws a circle, an ellipse and a line as an SVG document. It shows that the order of elements in the array sets the paint order.

**How it works:** "1 Elements" is a Code node that returns the two discs first and then the line across them. "2 Document" wraps them in a 300 by 180 SVG. "3 SVG" shows the drawing. It runs locally with no model or key.

**Try this:** Move the line to the start of the array in the Code node and run again to see it drawn underneath the discs.
